Fujibo Holdings.why: Fujibo's mainstay Polishing Pad Business makes CMP polishing pads for semiconductor devices and polishing pads for silicon wafers; it is the company's largest segment by sales and profit, so foundry wafer starts drive its stock.
Fujibo Holdings.evidence: Q1 results (07-31-2026): 'orders for polishing pads for semiconductor devices (CMP) remained strong as demand increased for semiconductors for use in advanced logic applications, fueled by the adoption of generative AI. Products for silicon wafer applications remained strong'

players.product: Polishing pads for semiconductor devices (CMP pads) and for silicon wafers (Polishing Pad Business)

quarterly_data.quarter: Fujibo Holdings quarterly results: Consolidated Financial Results for the Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fujibo Holdings Q1 of the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 (April-June 2026): net sales JPY 13,172 million, up 17.0% year on year; operating profit JPY 2,481 million, up 28.2%.
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 13,172 million net sales (+17.0%); JPY 2,481 million operating profit (+28.2%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Fujibo Holdings quarterly results: Consolidated Financial Results for the Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Polishing Pad Business Q1 (April-June 2026): orders for polishing pads for semiconductor devices (CMP) remained strong as demand increased for semiconductors for advanced logic applications, fueled by the adoption of generative AI; products for silicon wafer applications remained strong mainly due to the recovery of demand for memory chips; orders for hard disk applications remained strong on data center demand. Segment net sales JPY 6,499 million (+24.0%), operating profit JPY 1,997 million (+35.0%).
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 6,499 million segment net sales (+24.0%); JPY 1,997 million segment operating profit (+35.0%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Fujibo Holdings quarterly results: Consolidated Financial Results for the Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Polishing Pad Business: raw material prices have continued to rise due to the escalating tension in the Middle East; the company says it will minimize the impact by passing the increased costs on to product prices, while securing raw materials remains the top priority.

quarterly_data.quarter: Fujibo Holdings quarterly results: Consolidated Financial Results for the Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fujibo Holdings revised its forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 (from the one announced May 15, 2026) in light of Q1 results and the anticipated increase in demand for advanced semiconductors for AI applications: net sales JPY 54,900 million (+19.5%), operating profit JPY 9,900 million (+21.6%); six months ending September 30, 2026: net sales JPY 27,000 million, operating profit JPY 4,750 million.
quarterly_data.figure: FY ending March 2027: JPY 54,900 million net sales, JPY 9,900 million operating profit; H1: JPY 27,000 million net sales, JPY 4,750 million operating profit

quarterly_data.quarter: Fujibo Holdings quarterly results: Consolidated Financial Results for the Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Medium-term Management Plan 'Shinka 26-30' (from April 2026): the group is shifting its focus to the Polishing Pad and Industrial Chemicals Businesses and actively making capital expenditures; it aims for operating profit of JPY 10.0 billion at the earliest possible stage within the first three years, and net sales of JPY 65.0 billion with operating profit of JPY 13.0 billion in fiscal year 2030.
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 10.0 billion operating profit (first three years); JPY 65.0 billion net sales and JPY 13.0 billion operating profit (fiscal year 2030)

quarterly_data.quarter: Fujibo Holdings quarterly results: Consolidated Financial Results for the Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Non-current assets rose JPY 701 million to JPY 46,937 million at June 30, 2026, mainly due to an increase in property, plant and equipment from capital expenditures in the Polishing Pad Business.
